entries.content: It's great that you're feeling better. Antidepressant adjustments involve many factors including how long you've been stable, the specific medication's half-life, and your individual response patterns. Your prescriber has access to your full history and can help you think through timing.

Discontinuation symptoms from SSRIs typically emerge within 2-4 days of dose reduction but can sometimes appear later. Symptoms may include dizziness, sensory disturbances, sleep disruption, and mood changes. The severity and timing vary considerably between individuals and between different reduction attempts in the same individual.
